name: polyreview-js-toolchain
description: Vendored JS/TS analyzer toolchain for the code-review (polyreview) skill. Versions pinned per ADR-0017 (Node 20 LTS + 22 LTS); installed by scripts/setup.sh via `npm ci`. Not shipped in the PyPI wheel. dependency-cruiser's pin is a candidate validated cross-Node by s3.
//dependency-cruiser: ^16 is the F1-broken-on-modern-Node candidate; s3 confirms a Node 20+22 version and bumps this pin (ADR-0017 §3). Its integration test is xfail(strict) until then.
